issues.description: The problem statement's UML lists calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int without indicating it is static, while the later textual requirements explicitly state that calculateTotalPrice must be static. This mismatch between the diagram and the text can confuse students about whether calculateTotalPrice should be an instance or static method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent: either mark calculateTotalPrice as static in the UML/class diagram or remove the textual requirement that it be static. Clarify in the problem statement which form (static vs instance) students must implement so there is no ambiguity.
